Supplier or vendor master data used for supplier-level spend aggregation, sourcing, compliance, payment-term analysis, vendor segmentation, and joining procurement documents to the correct supplier entity.

EAA vendor-master data providing vendor classifications, organizational context, and reporting attributes. EAA vendor records display version or history behavior and require agreed current-state selection logic.
Commodity taxonomy and category attributes used to classify requisitions, purchase orders, invoice lines, items, and suppliers for category-level spend visibility and sourcing analytics.

Purchase-order line-level data containing item, quantity, amount, commodity, accounting, and related document references. Supports line-level spend, invoice matching, compliance checks, and sourcing analysis.
Purchase-order accounting distribution data used to allocate procurement spend by account, project, division, market, cost center, or other financial and organizational dimensions.
Reference data describing purchasing or organizational activities associated with procurement transactions. Supports operational classification and spend segmentation.
Division hierarchy and attributes used to roll up procurement spend and purchasing activity by Kroger organizational division.
Market hierarchy and attributes used to analyze purchasing activity and spend below the division level and above the store level.
Store reference data used to attribute purchasing activity and spend to specific stores or operating locations.
Bridge data connecting stores to markets and supporting validated organizational rollups from store to market and division.
Vendor classification reference data used to segment suppliers by defined vendor-type categories and support sourcing and spend analysis.
Data assigning vendors to one or more vendor-type categories. Supports supplier segmentation and category or sourcing analysis.

Invoice-processing, workflow, status, or exception-history data used to understand invoice review outcomes and operational exceptions. Its role in core spend reporting versus operational monitoring requires confirmation.
Payment records embedded within Coupa invoice payloads, including payable identifier, payment date, and payment amount. Supports paid-versus-unpaid analysis and invoice-payment traceability.
Item or catalog reference data used to associate procurement transactions with item numbers, manufacturer part numbers, commodity classifications, expenditure types, and asset categories.
User or requester information associated with procurement demand and approvals, including user identifier, employee number, division, location, cost center, and position where available.
Historical purchase-order change records used to analyze amendments, status changes, revised values, and the relationship between the current purchase order and prior versions.
